source: Scans in Dropbox: Lung Block/Follia Non Ciamb/FOLLIA Reti (58 PDFs, 1940-1975)
method: Signed pieces (bylines, end signatures, photo credits, letters) read page by page from 90 dpi renders by Claude (Opus pilot, Sonnet batches); issue date per page from footer/header/masthead. Not the TOC.
